title: BLACKOUTv3
features:
upported  Games

- [1] Rivals [🟢]
- [2] [FPS] FLICK [🟢]
- [3] Arsenal [🟢]
- [4] Raise Animals [🟢]
- [5] Westbound [🟢]
- [6] Driving Empire [🟢]
- [7] Shark Bite 2 [🟢]
- [8] Big Paintball 2 [🟢]
- [9] Blind Shot [🟢]
- [10] Fish It [🟢]

MORE++
⊕ Combat
Aimbot

Toggle on/off
Silent Aim
Camera Lock
Team Check (skip teammates)
Friend Check (skip friends)
Ignore Bots
Visibility Check (line-of-sight only)
Field of View slider (1–360°)
Max Distance slider (10–2000m)
Target Bone selector (Head, Neck, UpperTorso, LowerTorso, HumanoidRootPart)
Visual FOV circle (turns green when locked)

Auto Shot

Toggle — automatically fires at the nearest target

Misc Combat

No Recoil
No Spread
Spinbot (with speed slider 5–60°)

Keybinds: Aimbot, Auto Shot, Spinbot

👥 Players Tab

Live player list with avatars, health, distance, ping
Player alive/dead status indicator
Search bar with live filter
Sort by: Name, Distance, HP
Filter by: All, Alive, Dead, Enemy, Whitelisted
Per-player actions: Teleport to, Spectate, Whitelist/Unwhitelist, Add Note
Spectate mode with stop button
Auto-refreshes every 2 seconds


👁 Visuals / ESP
ESP Toggles

Master Switch
Team Check
Box ESP (via Highlight, GPU-rendered)
Name Tags
Distance labels
Health Bar (bar or numeric HP text)
Skeleton
Chams / See-Through (fill color + transparency)
Snaplines
Head Dot
Weapon Name

Settings

Max ESP distance (50–2000m)
Chams fill transparency slider

Per-element color pickers: Box, Name, Distance, Health Bar, Skeleton, Snapline, Head Dot, Weapon Label, Chams Fill, Chams Outline — with options: White, Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Orange, Purple, Rainbow, Team

⚙ Misc
Movement

Fly Mode (WASD + Space/Shift, speed slider 10–300)
Speed Boost (walk speed 16–150)
Infinite Jump
No Clip

Teleport

TP Behind Enemy (with distance slider)
TP Above Enemy
Respawn Teleport

Radar Mini-Map

Toggle, rotate with camera, size (80–300px), range (50–1000m)
Enemy color / Team color pickers

Utility

Anti-Flash
Anti-Stun
Remove Smoke/Fog
Grenade ESP (Highlight)
Flamethrower ESP
Item / Pickup ESP
Character Transparency (0–100%)

Keybinds: Fly, No Clip, TP Behind, TP Above, Respawn TP, Radar Toggle

📄 Configs

Notifications toggle
Watermark toggle
Auto Save Config
Auto Load on Start
Notification duration slider (1–8s)
Save / Load / Reset config to file (BlackoutMenu/config.json)
Toggle Menu Key (default: K)
Panic/Hide Key (default: End)


🛡 Anti-Detection & Compatibility

Executor detection (Synapse, Fluxus, KRNL, Xeno, Wave, Solara, Sentinel…)
Remote event name blocklist (blocks suspicious server calls)
Drawing API shim (fallback GUI renderer for executors without native Drawing)
Safe GUI parenting (CoreGui → gethui → PlayerGui)
Mobile toggle button support
